age.evidence: Healthy adult male Sprague e Dawley (SD) rats weighing 250 e 300 g

sex.evidence: Healthy adult male Sprague e Dawley (SD) rats ... left infusion rats (n = 70) or bilateral infusion rats (n = 34)

dosing.evidence: DOI, Sigma, catalog #D101, 5 μg/0.5 μL ... was dissolved in sterile saline. ... In all groups, 0.5 μL of liquid was microinjected via the guide cannula on days 1, 7, 14 and 21 (intra-OFC, left or bilateral).

group_housing.evidence: Unstressed rats were housed four per cage, while rats in the stressed group were caged individually (DOI/CON group is unstressed, i.e., group-housed).

day_night_flipped.evidence: They were maintained on a standard light/dark cycle (light on, 7:00–19:00 h) ... All behavioral studies were performed in quiet conditions between 9 h and 16 h.

assays.assay_description: Two-bottle choice (1% sucrose vs tap water, 200 mL each) in individual behavioural cages over 24 h on day 22, bottle positions switched at 12 h; sucrose preference index computed. Baseline SPT used for screening before group assignment. Left-OFC and bilateral-OFC infusion cohorts (vehicle, DOI, ketanserin, CUMS).

application_type.evidence: 0.5 μL of liquid was microinjected via the guide cannula (intra-OFC) on days 1, 7, 14 and 21

setup_habituation.evidence: 72 h before testing, rats were acclimated with two bottles of a 1% sucrose solution for 24 h

setup_restrain.evidence: rats housed in individual behavioral cages ... bottles of 1% sucrose solution (200 mL) and of tap water (200 mL) were presented

food_restriction.evidence: rats housed in individual behavioral cages were deprived of water and food for 24 h

water_restriction.evidence: rats housed in individual behavioral cages were deprived of water and food for 24 h

time_to_assay.evidence: microinjected via the guide cannula on days 1, 7, 14 and 21 ... This test was performed on day 22

sample_size.evidence: left infusion rats (n = 70) or bilateral infusion rats (n = 34); n = 18 for Vehicle/CON and Vehicle/CUMS group, n = 12 for DOI/CON and Ket/CUMS group, n = 10 for Ket/CON group (left); n = 6–8 (bilateral)

outcomes.summary: Intra-OFC DOI decreased the sucrose preference index in unstressed rats, mimicking CUMS; ketanserin did not affect controls but reversed the CUMS-induced decrease. Bilateral infusion gave similar results.
outcomes.statistics: Left: F4,65 = 4.827, P < 0.01; CUMS vs control P < 0.01; DOI vs control P < 0.05. Bilateral: F4,29 = 4.874, P < 0.01
outcomes.evidence: Similar to CUMS, DOI treatment caused a decrease of sucrose preference index in control animals (P < 0.05).

B1_num_measures.evidence: sucrose preference index (%) = (sucrose intake/total fluid intake) × 100

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: consumption was measured over a 24-h period (total only)

B5_social.evidence: rats housed in individual behavioral cages

E7_social_context.evidence: rats housed in individual behavioral cages

E8_food_water.evidence: bottles of 1% sucrose solution (200 mL) and of tap water (200 mL) were presented and consumption was measured over a 24-h period

D1_continuity.evidence: consumption was measured over a 24-h period (uninterrupted ≥6 h)

D2_session_duration.evidence: consumption was measured over a 24-h period

D3_recording_days.evidence: rats were screened ... based on their sucrose preference compared with baseline testing ... This test was performed on day 22

D4_baseline.evidence: After 7 days of recovery, rats were screened for symptoms of depressive-like behaviors based on their sucrose preference compared with baseline testing.

D5_followup.evidence: Test on day 22 after last microinjection on day 21; ≥24 h interval not explicitly stated.

D6_circadian.evidence: consumption was measured over a 24-h period

assays.assay_description: 5-min session in a 60×60×40 cm wooden open-field box (25 squares); locomotor activity (crossings), time in center, rearing and grooming scored with VideoMot2 (TSE). Left-OFC and bilateral-OFC infusion cohorts (vehicle, DOI, ketanserin, CUMS).

application_type.evidence: 0.5 μL of liquid was microinjected via the guide cannula (intra-OFC) on days 1, 7, 14 and 21

setup_habituation.evidence: Rats were placed in the test environment for 30 min before starting OFT (appears to be testing-room acclimation, not apparatus exposure)

setup_restrain.evidence: SD rats were individually placed in the center of the black square area and their activity was recorded for 5 min

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the open-field apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the open-field apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: Last microinjection on day 21; exact day/time of OFT relative to dosing not stated in text (only shown in Fig. 1C timeline).

sample_size.evidence: n = 18 for Vehicle/CON and Vehicle/CUMS group, n = 12 for DOI/CON and Ket/CUMS group, n = 10 for Ket/CON group (Fig. 3); n = 6–8 (Fig. 4, bilateral)

outcomes.summary: Intra-OFC DOI (left infusion) reduced locomotor activity, rearing and time in center, similar to CUMS; grooming was unaffected. Ketanserin reversed CUMS-induced reductions in locomotion and rearing. In bilateral infusions, only rearing differed significantly.
outcomes.statistics: Left: locomotion F4,65 = 2.747, P < 0.01; rearing F4,65 = 11.647, P < 0.01; time in center F4,65 = 3.186, P < 0.01; grooming F4,65 = 1.946, P > 0.05. Bilateral: rearing F4,29 = 3.331, P < 0.05; locomotion F4,29 = 2.267, P > 0.05; grooming F4,29 = 1.001, P > 0.05; time in center F4,29 = 1.920, P > 0.05
outcomes.evidence: The Vehicle/CUMS and DOI groups displayed reduced locomotor activity, rearing times and time in the center during open field tests (P < 0.01), respectively.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The spontaneous locomotor activity (times) and time in center (%) were assessed ... rearing and grooming behavior were measured

B4_ethological.evidence: rearing and grooming behavior were measured

B7_automated_classification.evidence: assessed using the VideoMot2 tracking system (TSE Inst., Germany) — commercial tracking system; when in doubt score 0

E1_environment_type.evidence: The open field apparatus was a wooden box consisting of 25 black square arenas (60 × 60 × 40 cm)

E7_social_context.evidence: SD rats were individually placed in the center

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the open field.

D1_continuity.evidence: their activity was recorded for 5 min

D5_followup.evidence: Timing of OFT relative to last dose not stated in text.

assays.assay_description: Rats suspended by the tail (tape, ~3 cm from tip) from a strain gauge in a three-walled compartment for one 6-min trial; immobility in the last 5 min measured by TSE tail suspension monitor. Left-OFC and bilateral-OFC infusion cohorts.

application_type.evidence: 0.5 μL of liquid was microinjected via the guide cannula (intra-OFC) on days 1, 7, 14 and 21

setup_habituation.evidence: No habituation to TST apparatus described.

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were suspended by their tail with tape ... from a strain gauge

time_to_assay.evidence: Last microinjection on day 21; exact day/time of TST relative to dosing not stated in text (only shown in Fig. 1C timeline).

sample_size.evidence: n = 18 for Vehicle/CON and Vehicle/CUMS group, n = 12 for DOI/CON and Ket/CUMS group, n = 10 for Ket/CON group (Fig. 3); n = 6–8 (Fig. 4, bilateral)

outcomes.summary: Intra-OFC DOI increased immobility time in unstressed rats, as did CUMS; ketanserin prevented the CUMS-induced increase. Bilateral infusions yielded similar results.
outcomes.evidence: In the tail suspension test, either CUMS exposure or DOI treatment significantly increased the immobility time (P < 0.01, P < 0.05).

B1_num_measures.evidence: their total duration of immobility in the last 5 min was calculated

B4_ethological.evidence: Immobility is not an ethological behaviour per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: Each rat was given 1 trial test

B7_automated_classification.evidence: calculated by the tail suspension monitor (TSE Inst., Germany) — strain-gauge immobility detection

E7_social_context.evidence: Each rat was given 1 trial test

D1_continuity.evidence: Each rat was given 1 trial test of 6 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Each rat was given 1 trial test

D5_followup.evidence: Timing of TST relative to last dose not stated in text.

judge_notes: All candidates agreed on three behavioural assays (SPT, OFT, TST); body weight, HPLC, Western blot and Golgi spine analysis excluded as non-behavioural.
Left-OFC and bilateral-OFC infusion cohorts collapsed into single assays (same paradigm, different infusion site); n_total = 70 + 34 = 104, min group n = 6 (bilateral n = 6–8).
Route coded as 'other' (intra-OFC microinjection, not i.c.v.) per 2/3 candidates; schedule 'repeated' (4 injections, days 1/7/14/21).
SPT B1 set to 1 measure (only sucrose preference index reported); gemma's score/value mismatch and deepseek's 2-3 rejected.
SPT E8 = Yes: water/sucrose bottles physically available during the 24-h test (qwen, deepseek).

SPT D4 = Yes per paper's baseline sucrose preference screening (qwen, gemma); for consistency D3 set to 2-7 days and D1 to continuous (24-h uninterrupted intake measurement ≥6 h), overriding modal 'single session'.
OFT setup_habituation changed to not_reported: 'placed in the test environment for 30 min' reads as testing-room acclimation, which the rubric excludes.
OFT/TST time_to_assay set to not_reported: only the SPT day (22) is stated in text; candidates' 1440/2880/30240 min values were inferred (gemma's >7 d clearly wrong as last dose was day 21).
